paragraphs.text: DeepSeek peak/off-peak price clock for the DeepSeek Harness composer HUD
# dsh-deepseek-peak-clock

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows whether the DeepSeek API is
in its **peak** or **off-peak** bil

ling window — right in the composer HUD row, next to turns,
tok/s and cache hit rate.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The countdown ticks every second. Hovering the cell shows the window end in your local time and the
current per-1M-token rates:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Schedule
Peak windows are **01:00–04:00** and **06:00–10:00 UTC**, everything else is off-peak at half price.
Since 2026-08-22 16:00 UTC the split only applies Monday–Friday Beijing time; Saturdays, Sundays an

d
Chinese public holidays are off-peak all day.

The rules are a port of the logic behind deepakness.com/deepseek
and its price clock extension, whic

h in turn
follow the official DeepSeek pricing page.
## Install
This is a Harness bundle: a package whose `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one Loader row.

1. Clone the repo somewhere stable (the profile links to the directory, so do not delete it).
2. Ins
tall it into your profile with the plugin manager, pointing at the checkout directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or add it by hand to your profile's Cordis composition:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

3. Refresh the Web GUI. The cell appears under the composer; it is session-scoped, so open a
session

the Web GUI. The cell appears under the composer; it is session-scoped, so open a
session to see it.
The Host half is a no-op: the schedule is pure UTC arithmetic, so the clock renders entirely in the
browser and works offline.
## Configuration
None. The plugin adds one locale namespace, one HUD cell and nothing else.
## Maintenance

`CN_HOLIDAYS` in `client.js` lists Chinese public holidays that DeepSeek bills off-peak all day.
The

State Council publishes the next year's arrangement around November, so add those dates when
they a

re announced. Everything else (windows, weekend rule) only changes when DeepSeek changes its
pricing

, which this plugin does not detect automatically — compare with the pricing page
occasionally.
## Layout
| File | Purpose |

| `index.js` | Host half (empty `apply`; no services, no network) |
| `client.js` | Schedule port +

the HUD cell component |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row that activates the bundle |
| `locale/en.

json`, `locale/zh.json` | Plugin title and description for the Plugins page |
| `icon.svg` | Half-gr
een/half-red clock icon |
## License
MIT. The schedule logic derives from DeepakNess's price clock; see the license file.
